notes:
### Added

- A pipeline's conversation shows a stage strip under its title bar: a 40px bar with what is building, in review and up next and a crab per running agent, which opens (and stays open or closed per pipeline) into the tickets with their step, branch, PRs and whether their CI passed. What needs you is a short list there; clicking it scrolls the conversation to a card with the question and its options, the plan to approve, the failed run to try again or the ticket a person moved on, which is where you answer. The title bar now says whether the pipeline runs, is paused or is holding, and why (#546)

### Changed

- Clicking a project in the sidebar opens its board (Productive, Trello, Linear, Jira, whatever it is linked to), and the board button is gone from the title bar. Projects without a linked board still open their latest conversation; the heading in the board's title bar takes you back to it (#543)

### Removed

- The Notes drawer is gone from the project title bar and the quick-ask tool list, nobody used it. Notes you wrote there stay where they are: the ones in the Inbox are still Inbox notes, and older ones stay in the vault's .relay/notes folder (#544)

### Fixed

- The board pipeline never moves a ticket back from where a person moved it on the board: a run that ends, a merged or closed PR, or review comments leave a ticket a person put in a later or done column where it is, and review comments no longer start its agent behind their back. The pipeline's conversation says so; Build with agent or the pick column starts the agent again, with the held review comments (#545)
